measurement_scope: Shared EPYC/RADV host and GPU; other tasks continued in parallel. Fresh paired ABBA samples quantify observed latency, not an isolated throughput guarantee. Absolute timings must not be compared with previous runs under different load.
discarded_experiment: Q5 minimum-correction reductions batched eight blocks at a time matched eight hardware fixtures but did not improve representative kernel timings; reverted before full-model validation.
limitations: GPU arithmetic qualified only on this AMD RADV device/driver and Q5_K_M artifact
Full 1024-token SWA eviction and 262144-token context not tested; capacity additionally bounded by storage-buffer range
F16 KV uses rounded F32 storage and saves no cache memory
Prefill remains sequential; performance measured only on nine single-token forwards
Other quantizations, GPU/drivers and last_loop KV unverified; last_loop rejected
Full repository/shared operator suites not rerun; prior shared convolution/SiLU 1 ULP failure remains unresolved
